title: Callvale before: reports on each instance's volume
claim: Each web instance keeps the reports it creates on its own volume, so a download that reaches another instance fails.
alt: Before: a load balancer sends requests to web instances in three zones. Each instance writes reports to its own volume, so a download that reaches another instance fails.

edges.label: download
edges.say: A user asks for a report through the load balancer.
The load balancer sends the download to another web instance.

edges.label: no report
edges.say: That instance does not have the report, so the download fails.

edges.label: temp files
edges.say: Each conversion worker keeps its temporary files on its own volume.
